bank.retain_mission: Extract external API documentation summaries, third-party library signatures, dependency version quirks, official best practices, and web research findings. Ignore transient search results and irrelevant web pages.
bank.observations_mission: Track third-party library updates, API deprecations, external framework best practices, and external technical documentation snapshots.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a structured documentation briefing highlighting API signatures, external library quirks, best practices, and verified web research.

mental_models.name: External Library & API Documentation
mental_models.source_query: What third-party libraries, APIs, or frameworks are used, and what are their key signatures, options, and usage examples?

mental_models.name: Known Library Quirks & Gotchas
mental_models.source_query: What third-party library bugs, version incompatibilities, or subtle API gotchas were discovered during research?
